findings.title: Unlimited Liability
findings.quote: Customer has unlimited liability for all losses, including indirect and consequential damages.
findings.rationale: The clause imposes unlimited liability on the Customer, which deviates from the preference to cap aggregate liability at fees paid in the preceding 12 months and exclude indirect damages.
findings.proposed_language: Customer's aggregate liability shall be capped at the fees paid in the preceding 12 months, and the Customer shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential damages.

findings.title: Lack of Reciprocal Indemnity
findings.quote: Customer indemnifies Supplier for all claims connected to use of the service; Supplier owes no indemnity to Customer.
findings.rationale: The clause only provides indemnity from Customer to Supplier without a reciprocal obligation from Supplier to Customer, which does not satisfy the requirement for appropriately scoped indemnities.
findings.proposed_language: Both parties shall indemnify each other for claims arising from their respective negligence, misconduct, or breach of this agreement.

findings.title: Early non-renewal deadline
findings.quote: Automatic annual renewal can be cancelled only with notice at least ninety days before renewal.
findings.rationale: Non-renewal requires 90 days of notice before renewal, exceeding the playbook maximum of 60 days.
findings.proposed_language: Either party may prevent automatic renewal by giving written notice at least sixty days before the renewal date.

findings.title: Supplier Convenience Termination Notice

findings.proposed_language: Supplier may terminate for convenience on at least thirty days' notice and must refund all unused prepaid fees.
